# What should your shared kitchen charge?

> Free planner for shared and commissary kitchen owners. Enter rent, costs, stations, hourly rate and memberships; get break-even rate, break-even utilization, member effective rate and a profit grid. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
